title: Area-code shard C pass 34 — 857 / 860 / 863

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public organizational actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 857, 860, and 863?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public organizational-role enumeration, seed-family expansion, and explicit uncertainty handling. X and Reddit discovery did not depend on official APIs.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, membership, public role, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay/locality-derived NPA hits, geographic association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Reused the canonical Black Rose/Rosa Negra Boston Local and added a fresh current/locality relation; added Mutual Aid Eastie from direct 857 first-party contact evidence. Boston Food Not Bombs was re-verified as current but not rematerialized because this bounded batch retained the stronger two nonduplicate identities.

Added Hartford Food Not Bombs from current first-party weekly-meal evidence and Mutual Aid Hartford from current first-party programs. Hartford FNB's FAQ explicitly says it has no board or director. Added Gabbie Barnes only as a directly stated public Mutual Aid Hartford member; no ideology inferred.

Added Indivisible Polk Florida from current first-party Lakeland/Polk mutual-aid and civic activity and Defund Oligarchy / Blessed by Liberty from current first-party Polk County/Lakeland organizing and outreach. Historical Florida anarchist-youth material remains a discovery lead only and was not promoted to current.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-organizational-role enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public organizational-role enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 857, 860, and 863.
